package fixture

import "fmt"

// Flagged: a raw value inside the string's quotes.
func badRaw(sha string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"commit":{"url":"https://api.github.com/commits/%s"}}`, sha)
}

// Flagged: %q is GO quoting, not JSON -- it emits \a, \v, \xNN and
// \UNNNNNNNN, none of which JSON accepts.
func badQuoted(sha string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"commit":{"sha":%q}}`, sha)
}

// Flagged: a non-string slot still bypasses the encoder.
func badNumeric(n int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"number":%d}`, n)
}

// Not flagged: a percent escape in a URL is not a verb.
func okPercentEscape() string {
	return `{"url":"https://example.com/a%20b"}`
}

// Not flagged: the format string is not JSON.
func okNonJSON(sha string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("https://api.github.com/commits/%s", sha)
}

// Not flagged: an error message is not a JSON document, even though the quoted
// operand puts a quote next to a colon.
func okErrorMessage(err error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("Get \"x\": %w", err)
}
